# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 71 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 71

**1** Jesus said: "I will destroy this house, and no one will be able to build it again."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- **ⲡⲉⲉⲓⲏⲉⲓ** / *peei-ēi*: "this house" — the house/dwelling; possibly the Temple, but in Thomas without the Temple context
- Cf. Mark 14:58 / Matthew 26:61 (false testimony at trial): "I will destroy this temple made with hands and in three days build another"
- Thomas's version is starker: no "temple," no three days, no rebuilding — simply destruction without restoration
- The saying in Thomas may refer to the destruction of the body/ego, not a physical building
- "No one will be able to build it again" — the finality is absolute; this is not a resurrection promise
